meta.title: Native sound and music runtime audit
meta.scope: read-only audit; no assets downloaded, generated, played, or packaged; no ports opened

summary.headline_gap: No native audio runtime exists. The browser reference has a synth SFX seam that is never instantiated in app code, one menu-music loop, and four of five mapped SFX cues have no producers.

evidence: Acceptance rg sweep over native/ matches only std::mutex, 'spatial backpack' inventory comments (native/include/verdigris/core.hpp:639), and a volume comment in native/tests/session_tests.cpp:532.

native/CMakeLists.txt declares no audio library, source, or dependency (targets: verdigris_core, verdigris_networking, verdigris_core_tests, verdigris_networking_tests, verdigris_server, verdigris_client_session).

core_event_log.type: Simulation::emit(EventType, actor_id, item_id, trophy_id, text, value) appended to events_ vector with tick stamp
core_event_log.note: Event struct carries type, ids, text discriminator, value, tick — sufficient for cue selection without any simulation changes.

presentation_event_seam.type: C3 session seam (D-122): transient PresentationEvent stream drained by the client; carries no gameplay authority
presentation_event_seam.enum: native/client/presentation_events.hpp:12-35 (ConnectionEstablished, ConnectionLost, SessionReady, AttackStarted, DamageApplied, ActorDied, ItemDropped, ItemPickedUp, ItemEquipped, ExtractionCompleted, ScionDied, Telegraph, Message, ProtocolError)
presentation_event_seam.drain_api: Session::drain_events() at native/client/session.hpp:94; implementations local_session.cpp:158, remote_session.cpp:525
consumers_today: native/client/main.cpp:1737 ingest_events() — local pipeline turns events into procedural visual effects only
coverage_gaps_for_audio: No InstanceEntered / ExpeditionPhaseChanged / RouteUnlocked / RelicResurfaced mapped into PresentationEventType yet (zone/sting cues would need them).
No BuffApplied/BuffExpired mapping (war-cry cue would need it).
No TrophyPickedUp/TrophyDropped mapping (trophy cues fall back to item cues).
PresentationEvent lacks a tick field; core Event has tick (core.hpp:261).

combat_hit.audio_relevance: primary combat feedback input on the remote path

client_ingest_pattern_to_extend.description: Cursor-based drain: state.processed_events advances over sim.events(); switch on event.type pushes transient effects. An AudioMixer could sit beside this switch consuming the same stream.
client_ingest_pattern_to_extend.local: native/client/main.cpp:1736-1810 (AttackTelegraphed, AttackStarted, BuffApplied, DamageApplied, ActorDied cases visible)

buses_spatialization_priorities_voice_li.evidence: Sweep shows no bus, priority, voice-limit, or spatializer concepts in any audio context; nearest 'spatial' hits are the inventory footprint system (core.hpp:639, docs/vision.md:37,100).

music_states_transitions.browser_reference: menu loop start/stop only; no in-game music state machine exists in either codebase

ui_cues.browser_reference: Settings copy promises 'Combat, loot, and world cues' (src/components/slots/Settings.vue:52); only loot is actually emitted (sound:loot)

device_lifecycle.browser_reference: AudioContext created lazily and resumed after user gesture; suspended-context cues are dropped, not queued (src/core/audio/sound-system.js:31-45)

browser_reference: Persistent soundEffects boolean default true (src/stores/ui.js:22,80 via setSettings)
Settings toggle emits SETTINGS:SOUND on the bus (src/components/slots/Settings.vue:107-112) — no listener anywhere (dead event)
Music mute is per-component <audio>.muted with aria-label Unmute/Mute music (src/components/sub/AudioMainMenu.vue:7,110-116)

existing: vitest fake AudioContext asserting oscillator counts/types and suspended-context drop behavior (tests/unit/sound-system.spec.js:7-60)
bus $emit spies assert sound producers without audio hardware (tests/unit/loot-first-find.spec.js:241-254)
native scenario harness drives dispatch->ingest->present and asserts recorded ops (native/README.md:90-118); render_list.hpp op-recording precedent for an equivalent audio-op recorder
session_tests drain_events() loops for presentation-event assertions (native/tests/session_tests.cpp:71,163,201,404,457,507)
deterministic_test_seams.requirement_for_successor: audio output must be an injectable sink so headless tests assert scheduled cues, never real devices

packaging.native: CMake targets listed under native_surfaces.audio_runtime evidence; no asset pipeline, no audio codecs linked
packaging.browser: single mp3 shipped as a static component-referenced asset (~4.83 MB on disk, src/assets/audio/music/main_menu.mp3); archived review flags the 5 MB main_menu mp3 as bundle bloat recommending lazy-load (docs/archive/code-review.md:229,282)
packaging.constraint: resource capsule forbids downloading or generating assets in this task; successor must keep synthetic-placeholder generation offline and license-clean

repo_constraints: Native proof is deliberately dependency-free C++20 (native/README.md:3)
platform/ is the reserved seam for focused SDL3/winit-style platform decisions (native/platform/README.md)
Simulation must stay headless/deterministic; audio is presentation-only (AGENTS.md native boundary; constitution native architecture invariant)

candidate_backends.name: miniaudio (header-only, WASAPI on Windows / CoreAudio on macOS)
candidate_backends.pros: no link-time deps, matches dependency-free ethos, device enumeration + duplex built in
candidate_backends.cons: vendored third-party header needs an ownership/licensing decision

candidate_backends.name: SDL3 audio subsystem
candidate_backends.pros: aligns with the already-named SDL3 platform direction, cross-platform device hotplug
candidate_backends.cons: larger dependency than audio alone requires today

candidate_backends.name: raw WASAPI + CoreAudio behind one seam
candidate_backends.cons: two hand-maintained backends; highest long-term cost

lifecycle_requirements: suspend/resume on focus and gesture unlock parity with browser behavior

synth_sfx_seam.evidence: Only importer is tests/unit/sound-system.spec.js:4; rg 'SoundSystem|sound-system' finds no src/ import outside the module itself

sound:loot.params: 520->620 Hz then 780->920 Hz sine pair, vol 0.05/0.045

sound:final-death.params: 220->42 Hz saw + 110->32 Hz sine layered, vol 0.085/0.065

synth_sfx_seam.synthesis: per-cue oscillator+gain envelopes direct to context.destination (sound-system.js:41-74); no buses, no voice cap

server_side_audio_events.evidence: server/ sweep matches only the word 'sounder' in flavor text (server/core/items/vesselforge/verdigris-pack.js:292); loot chime is derived client-side from inventory diff

negative_controls.name: combat:hit (remote wire) / DamageApplied (core event)
negative_controls.kind: load-bearing combat event with no audio consumer
negative_controls.evidence: Emitted for every strike with amount/critical/attackStyle fields (native/src/networking.cpp:2005; core emission native/src/core.cpp:417,714); consumed exclusively for visuals (native/client/main.cpp:1774-1801). No audio consumer exists in any codebase.
negative_controls.successor_requirement: first cue the placeholder runtime must own

negative_controls.name: SETTINGS:SOUND
negative_controls.evidence: Emitted at src/components/slots/Settings.vue:109; rg finds zero listeners.

negative_controls.name: music:start
negative_controls.kind: listener with no producer (inverse dead seam)
negative_controls.evidence: Listener registered at src/components/sub/AudioMainMenu.vue:77; zero emitters repo-wide, so menu music starts only by manual button click.

negative_controls.name: sound:combat-hit / sound:monster-kill / sound:zone / sound:final-death
negative_controls.kind: mapped cues with zero producers, inside a system never instantiated
negative_controls.evidence: Map at src/core/audio/sound-system.js:3-9; producer search across src/ server/ tests/ returns nothing; SoundSystem imported only by its spec.

constitution_alignment.authority: docs/product/VERDIGRIS_CONSTITUTION.md native architecture invariant: presentation requests actions, simulation resolves, simulation emits results, presentation displays results
constitution_alignment.implication: Audio must consume the post-resolution Event/PresentationEvent streams and never write simulation state; legacy-denylist contains no audio entries, so carry-over adjudication is still open for the successor task
